verses.text: Ay jun k'ual ix yal winhaj Samuel t'a winhaj Saúl icha tik: --Ha Jehová ix in chekani ayik ix ach in sik'ankanoch reyal t'a Israel haton schonhab'. Yuj chi' cha ab' tas syal Jehová t'ayach.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' amalecita yujto yak'nak owal heb' yet' heb' israel ayik skotnak heb' t'a Egipto.

Yuj chi' ol ach b'at ak' owal yet' heb', tza satel heb' yet' tastak ay t'a heb', malaj junok makan b'aj tz'ok' a k'ool. Tza milcham masanil heb' winak, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' hato yalji yet' pax nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' camello yet' nok' b'uru, tza satel smasanil, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix smolb'ej heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ix sayan yil heb' winh t'a Telaim. Ay 10 mil heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' 200 mil heb' yik juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' t'a chonhab' Amalec, ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh yet' heb' soldado t'a yol jun takinh melem.

Ix yalanb'at winh t'a heb' quenita: --Elanhek t'a skal heb' amalecita, yik manh ol ex in satel yet' heb', yujto ok'nak he k'ool t'a heb' ketisraelal ayik sjawinak heb' t'a tik, ayik spetoj heb' t'a Egipto, xchib'at winh t'a heb'. Elanhchamel ix yik'el sb'a heb' quenita chi' t'a skal heb' amalecita chi'.

Ix k'och winhaj Saúl chi' yak' owal yet' heb' amalecita chi', ix schaanel yich winh t'a Havila, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Shur t'a smojonalxo Egipto t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' amalecita chi' yuj heb'.
Ix syamankot winhaj Agag heb', haton winh sreyal heb' amalecita chi'. Pitzan winh ix syaman winh heb'. Haxo masanil juntzanhxo heb' amalecita, ix miljicham heb'.

Palta a winhaj Saúl chi' yet' heb' soldado, maj smilchamlaj winhaj Agag chi' heb'. Maj smilpaxchamlaj nok' wakax heb' te wach', nok' kalnel, nok' yunetak wakax te b'ak'uech, nok' yunetak kalnel yet' juntzanhokxo tastak te ay stojol. Haxo masanil tas malaj wal yelk'ochi, ix satel heb' smasanil.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel icha tik:

Skus in k'ool yujto ix wak'och winhaj Saúl tik reyal, yujto tzin spatikejkanel winh, maj sk'anab'ajej winh tas ix wala', xchi t'a winh. Ix kus sk'ool winhaj Samuel, yuj chi' pilan ak'wal ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.

Haxo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, te ak'walto ix b'at winh yil winhaj Saúl chi'. Palta haxo ix alchaj t'a winh to ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Carmel. Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun monumento winh yuj yik'anchaanh sb'a. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a Gilgal.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Samuel chi' ta'. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh. Toxo ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix yala', xchi winh.
--¿Tas yaj nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax swab' yok' chi'? xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.

--Ha t'a chonhab' Amalec ix kot nok', yujto a wal nok' kalnel te wach' ix yik'kot heb' soldado yet' nok' wakax yik ol och silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Haxo masanil juntzanhxo, ix ko sateli, xchi winh.
--Numan tzach aji. Ol wal t'ayach tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin t'a q'uiq'ui t'ak'wal, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. --Al an, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha t'a yalanhtaxo malaj elk'och a naani, palta ach och yajalil t'a masanil yinhtilal Israel. Ha Jehová ix ach ak'anoch sreyalok ko chonhab' tik.
Ach schekanpaxb'at a satel juntzanh heb' amalecita malaj swach'il tas sk'ulej yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
¿Tas yuj maj a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach, ina to ix ik'kot tastak t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'? Te chuk tas ix a k'ulej t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Maay, ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix yala', ix in xit'eq'ui, ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix schek in k'ulej. Ix wik'kot winhaj Agag sreyal heb' amalecita chi', ix in satanel masanil heb' anima ta'.

Haxo heb' soldado ix ik'ankot nok' skalnel heb' yet' nok' wakax wach' t'a skal nok' to yowalil satjieli. Ix yik'ankot nok' heb', yik tz'ak'chaj nok' silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a Gilgal tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Samuel chi': Ste stzalaj Jehová tato sko k'anab'ajej tas syala', t'a yichanh juntzanh silab' sko nhustz'a t'ay. Yel xo te wach' tato sko cha kab' tas syala', t'a yichanh pax sko nhustz'a xepual nok' kalnel t'ay.

Tato sko pitej ko b'a t'a Jehová, lajan ko mul icha smul heb' naumel lolonel. Tato skik'chaanh ko b'a, max ko k'anab'ajej tas syala', lajan wal ko mul icha smul heb' tz'em kuman t'a komon Dios. Yujto ix a patikejel tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ol ach spatikejpaxel yet' a reyal tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Yel toni, ix och in mul, maj in k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová yet' tas ix al t'ayin, yujto ix in xiw t'a heb' soldado ajun wet'ok, ix in cha wab' tas ix yal heb'.
Elokab' t'a a k'ool to tzin ak' niwank'olal yuj in mul ix ochi, meltzajanh wet'ok tzonh och ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.
--Manh ol in meltzajlaj het'ok, yujto ix a patikejel tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ol ach yik'el t'a reyal t'a ko chonhab' Israel tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Haxo yik ix meltzaj winhaj Samuel chi' yalani, ix och yub'naj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a sti' spichul winh, ix nhik'chaj yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Icha wal ix utej a nhik'chitan in pichul tik, icha chi' ol yutej Jehová yik'anel opisio t'a reyal t'a yol a k'ab', ol yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' junxo ketchonhab' ek'to wach' t'a ichanh.
Yowalil ol elk'och jun tik, yujto a Jehová skik'chaanh a onh israel onh tik, malaj b'aj syesej, malaj b'aj sk'ex spensar ichok anima, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' --Yeltoni ix och in mul, palta elokab' t'a a k'ol tzach meltzaj wet'ok yik ay welk'och t'a yichanh heb' yajalil ko chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh heb' ketchonhab' smasanil. Meltzajanh wet'ok, tzonh och ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Samuel chi' yet' winh, ix och winhaj Saúl chi' ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi': --Ik'ekkot winhaj Agag sreyal heb' Amalec chi' t'a wichanh, xchi winh. Ix te tzalaj winhaj Agag chi' ayik ix jawi winh t'a yichanh winhaj Samuel chi', manhxo ol chamlaj winh snaani.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh: --Yuj k'een espada tik tzijtum heb' ix ix, ix kan t'a manh uneal. Icha wal ix ajkan heb' ix chi', icha chi' ol aj skan ix a nun, xchi winh. Maj yak' niwank'olal winh, ix skotakxikanb'at winhaj Agag chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Gilgal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winh t'a Ramá, ix meltzajpax winhaj Saúl t'a spat t'a Gabaa.
Ayik pitzanto winhaj Samuel chi', majxo b'atlaj winh yil winhaj Saúl chi', palta skus winh yuj winh. Ix kuspax Jehová yujto ix yak'och winhaj Saúl sreyalok Israel.
